sourceEvidence.summary: Persistent Chrome verified the primary KJB Google Ads account and excluded a cancelled duplicate account. Campaign #1 was enabled as Performance Max at an observed $20 per day, with 54,814 impressions, $585.42 spend, and zero conversions in the last 30 days. This live read supersedes stale pause context, but the delivery and metrics are evidence only; tracking and appointment quality remain the first optimization gates.

budgetBaseline.basis: Observed on the enabled primary-account Performance Max campaign; this is a read-only baseline and never permission to spend.

requiredAssets: extensions tied to the appointment path
copyRequirements: speak to real bridal shopping intent
avoid unsupported inventory or appointment claims

dailyOptimizationChecks: confirm the primary KJB account and exclude the cancelled duplicate
antiRegressionRules: Do not pause, restart, or otherwise change Google from stale pause context or an internal draft.
Do not optimize toward appointments until real appointment conversion rows are verified.
Never count routing tests as leads or bookings.
Never route work to the cancelled KJB duplicate account.
Keep KJB Google and Meta reporting distinct even when the destination page is shared.
